name: ENVE 2310E
title: Environmental Engineering Fundamentals
description: (Also offered as CE 2310E.) Concepts from aqueous chemistry, biology, and physics applied in a quantitative manner to environmental problems and solutions. Mass and energy balances, chemical reaction engineering. Quantitative and fundamental description of water and air pollution problems. Environmental regulations and policy, pollution prevention, risk assessment. Written and oral reports.
requirement_description: CHEM 1125Q or CHEM 1128Q or CHEM 1148Q; CHEM 1128Q or CHEM 1148Q may be taken concurrently.
